explanation: erdosproblems.com/968: Erdős and Prachar proved Σ_{p_n < x} |u_{n+1} − u_n| ≍ (log x)². The Lean statement sums |u(n+1) − u(n)| over n < primeCounting' x (the number of primes < x) and asserts Θ((log x)²). With the 0-based shift this corresponds to the classical differences u_{k+1} − u_k for k = 1..π(x) (off by at most one bounded term relative to the page's range), which does not affect a Θ statement. Faithful.
